recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up source work is needed for FHIR-34329; the related Patient.link cleanup issues should be handled only if selected for their own reconciliation.
issue_request: FHIR-34329 was Published with a Persuasive with Modification resolution for FHIR-core Patient. It requested that Patient.link include Patient or RelatedPerson and refer to the same actual individual instead of only another patient resource concerning the same actual patient.
initial_application: The issue was already applied in source history. FHIR-32874 commit fb4572833f aligned Patient.link short and definition to "a Patient or RelatedPerson resource that concerns the same actual person," and FHIR-34329 commit a19cfd8bfe changed Patient.link from actual person to actual individual. FHIR-34156 commit 00eacab651 later aligned Patient.link.other to the same wording.
additional_context: Patient is active in source/fhir.ini, and source/patient/structuredefinition-Patient.xml currently has Patient.link short and definition as "Link to a Patient or RelatedPerson resource that concerns the same actual individual." Patient.link.other targets both Patient and RelatedPerson and has the same definition. The source uses "a" rather than FHIR-34329's proposed "another," but that wording was established by FHIR-32874 and avoids the prior patient-only ambiguity. Later FHIR-41417 removed stale narrative guidance that Patient.link was only for Patient resources.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. The current active source already reflects the requested RelatedPerson inclusion, corrected casing, and actual-individual wording, and no conflicting patient-only Patient.link wording remains.
